# Buildora — Build. Remix. Ship.

> Creative components for serious developers.

Buildora is a premium open-source, registry-driven component platform for
creative, interactive, production-ready developer components.
One component definition powers website, docs, playground, search, and install.
Accessibility-first: creative interactions never remove semantic behavior.
Flow: Discover → Interact → Inspect → Copy → Install → Remix → Ship.
Version: 0.1.0. License: MIT.

## Install (shadcn-compatible registry)

Pattern (from `registry/registry.json` `installBase`):

```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @buildora/{component}
```

Example:

```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @buildora/magnetic-button
```

```tsx
import { MagneticButton } from "@/components/buildora/magnetic-button";

export function Demo() {
  return <MagneticButton strength={0.35}>Ship it</MagneticButton>;
}
```

Registry endpoints:
- `https://buildora-hazel.vercel.app/r/{component}.json`
- Local: `/r/{component}.json` (served from `registry/generated/`)

Rebuild / validate (source of truth is `scripts/catalog.ts`):

```bash
pnpm registry:build     # emits registry/components/*.json, registry/generated/*.json, registry/registry.json, apps/web/lib/registry-data.generated.ts
pnpm registry:validate  # schema + status check
pnpm registry:llms      # regenerates this file
```

## Not using Tailwind

Every component with a TSX source also ships a CSS variant, generated from
that same source by `pnpm registry:css` — so the two cannot drift. Link the
token file and the component's CSS and it looks the same with no Tailwind setup:

```css
@import "@/styles/buildora/tokens.css";
@import "@/styles/buildora/magnetic-button.css";
```

## Components (179 unique slugs, 179 registry entries; one line each)

- accordion: Disclosure stack with expanded-state semantics.
- accordion-smooth: Accordion with animated height transition and rotating chevron.
- advanced-table: Sortable, filterable, paginated table with semantic <table> markup.
- agent-timeline: Agent activity timeline (plan → act → observe) with status semantics.
- ai-review-edit: Diff-style review UI for AI-generated content (accept / edit / reject).
- alert-dialog: Confirm/cancel dialog with destructive variant.
- animated-border: Border that traces itself around the element on view.
- animated-counter-badge: Badge that increments a counter with a spring pop when its value changes.
- animated-gradient-text: Text filled with an animated shifting gradient.
- attachment-prompt: Prompt input with removable attachment chips and send.
- avatar: Identity avatar with fallback initials and group stacking.
- avatar-stack-hover: Stacked avatars that spread apart on hover with spring.
- backdrop: One ambient background, nine variants (aurora, grid, dots, noise, mesh, beams, rise, meteors, ripple). CSS-first, decorative, deterministic layout.
- badge: Status badges and removable chips with variant tones.
- badge-pulse: Badge with a pulsing dot indicator for live status.
- bento-grid: Configurable grid with per-item spans.
- blueprint-loader: Drafting-sheet placeholder that draws its dashed frame while ghost rows ghost in behind a scanning beam. Progress and indeterminate.
- blur-text-entrance: Headline that resolves from a blurred, scaled state into sharp focus on view.
- bounce-button: Button that bounces with a spring on click.
- breadcrumb: Ancestor trail with current-page semantics.
- button: Base button with variants and sizes. Foundation for everything clickable.
- calendar: Month grid with real dates, gridcell semantics and today marked.
- checkbox: Accessible checkbox with label and indeterminate support.
- checkbox-bounce: Checkbox with a bouncing checkmark on toggle.
- code-editor: Split code/preview surface. A textarea, not an editor engine.
- comet-ring-spinner: Comet head racing around a ring of fading trail dots. Pure CSS transforms, role=status, frozen under reduced motion.
- command-palette: Keyboard-first command surface with fuzzy matching and combobox semantics.
- comment-thread: Resolve/reopen comment thread.
- confirm-morph: One button, two identities: idle → confirm strip → animated check. aria-live, auto-revert, danger variant.
- contact-form-reveal: Contact form whose fields stagger in on scroll with focus-driven lift.
- context-menu: Right-click menu with keyboard fallback trigger.
- count-up: A number that counts to its value when it scrolls into view. Announced once.
- cta-block: Centered call-to-action with actions and optional stats.
- cursor-fx: Pointer-following glow in four modes (glow, spotlight, trail, blob). One rAF loop, pointer-fine only, silent under reduced motion.
- cursor-trail-dot: Small trailing dot that follows the pointer with spring lag and fades when idle.
- detent-dial: Rotary knob with Gaussian tick-wave emphasis around the active detent. Drag, wheel, or arrows; role=slider.
- dialog: Focus-trapped modal dialog with overlay and escape handling.
- diff-viewer: Side-by-side line comparison with added/removed semantics.
- drag-dismiss: Card you flick away. Velocity decides, not distance alone. Escape works too.
- draggable-card-pile: Riffled stack: the top card drags out past a threshold and cycles to the back with spring physics. Enter flings for keyboard.
- drawer: Bottom-anchored drawer panel for mobile-first flows.
- drawer-slide: Side drawer that slides in from the edge with spring easing.
- dropdown-cascade: Dropdown menu whose items cascade in with staggered fade.
- dropdown-menu: Trigger-anchored menu with items, labels, and checks.
- dynamic-island: Morphing status pill for live app state. A live region, not decoration.
- echo-stack: Outlined echo copies drift above the word and intensify on hover. Pure CSS, zero re-renders.
- elastic-slider: Rubber-band slider: the knob over-stretches at the rails and snaps back with spring physics. role=slider + arrows/Home/End.
- elastic-underline: Link underline that stretches and snaps back on hover with spring physics.
- expandable-sidebar: Hover-expanding rail sidebar with delayed reveal.
- fade-in-image: Image that fades and scales in on load with blur placeholder.
- fade-stagger-list: List whose items fade and slide up in staggered sequence on view.
- feature-grid: Three-up feature grid with tags and copy.
- file-tree: Accessible tree with expand/collapse and keyboard support.
- floating-label-input: Input whose label floats up on focus with a spring, themed border.
- floating-navbar: Scroll-aware floating navigation pill.
- floating-object: 3D hovering objects with perspective tilt on hover, floating animation, and drop shadow.
- focus-blur-list: List rows where the hovered/focused one stays crisp and siblings sink back with blur + dim. Focus mirrors hover.
- fresnel-orb: Iridescent orb of layered conic and radial gradients with drifting orientation, rim highlight and caustic core. Pure CSS.
- fx-button: Real button with six finishes (none, shimmer, glow, ripple, gradient-border, liquid). Native semantics throughout.
- fx-card: Card shell with six pointer effects (tilt, spotlight, glare, holographic, wobble, glass). Ref-driven, no re-render per move.
- gooey-menu: FAB whose actions fan out as fused SVG-goo blobs with crisp labels riding on top. Escape and outside-click close.
- grab-roller-strip: Physical roller strip you drag sideways; it settles on the nearest label under a fixed marker with flanks in fade flow.
- gradient-border-card: Card with an animated conic-gradient border that rotates and pauses on hover.
- handwritten-annotation: Playful handwritten-style text annotations with hand-drawn arrow SVGs.
- hold-button: Press and hold to confirm, with live progress. A real behaviour, not a finish.
- horizontal-scroll: Scroll-driven horizontal panning section with mobile fallback.
- hover-card: Delayed hover preview card with configurable side.
- hover-lift-image: Image that lifts with shadow and slight zoom on hover, with smooth easing.
- hover-reveal-overlay: Card with an overlay that slides up on hover to reveal details.
- image-zoom-pan: Image that zooms and pans toward the cursor on hover, clamped to bounds.
- infinite-marquee: Seamless scrolling row that pauses on hover.
- inline-word-roll: Rolling word slot for inline headlines: slot width eases to the measured word as each term slides up, clipped.
- input: Labeled text input with variants, sizes, and error states.
- interactive-dropzone: Proximity-reactive dropzone with progress visualization and error recovery.
- json-viewer: Collapsible JSON viewer with mono styling.
- kbd: Keyboard shortcut glyphs with chord composition.
- letter-wave: Hover, focus or optional autoloop sends a sine wave rippling through the letters. Real text in aria-label.
- liquid-gauge: Ring meter filled with two out-of-phase liquid waves, clipped and animated. role=meter with valuetext.
- log-viewer: Filterable log stream with role=log semantics.
- logo-cloud: Customer logo row with label. Logos only, no taglines.
- magnetic-button: A real <button> with spring magnetic attraction to the cursor. Tactile, accessible, production-ready.
- magnetic-cursor-ring: Ring that follows the cursor with magnetic lag and scales on click.
- magnetic-dropzone: Dropzone that leans toward a file-drag cursor and pulses its field; browse input fallback; dropped files list with removers.
- magnetic-nav-pill: Floating nav pill that slides to the active item with a spring and attracts the cursor.
- magnification-dock: Dock whose icons grow with cursor proximity, on a continuous spring.
- marquee-logo-strip: Infinite horizontal logo marquee that pauses on hover and freezes under reduced motion.
- masonry-layout: Pinterest-style masonry columns.
- matrix-decode: Characters scramble through glyphs and lock in left-to-right with stochastic jitter. rAF-driven, resolves once.
- mobile-header: iOS-style screen header: back bar, centered title, collapsing large title, section headers, and inset settings groups.
- mobile-nav: Bottom mobile tab bar with labeled items, active pill, badges, and safe-area padding.
- modal-fade-scale: Modal dialog that fades and scales in with backdrop blur.
- modal-stack: Stacked modal manager with push/pop/replace semantics.
- model-selector: Accessible model picker with status dot.
- morph-select: Select whose trigger stretches into the options list and seals back into a pill. Listbox semantics, arrow nav, outside close.
- navbar: Sticky header bar with logo, center, and actions slots.
- number-counter-reveal: Animated counter that counts to its value when scrolled into view, announced once.
- number-wheel: Odometer counters: digits roll on vertical reels with staggered cascades. Locale grouping, prefix, suffix, count-up.
- pagination: Page controls with prev/next and numbered buttons.
- parallax-image-layer: Image layer that translates at a different rate than scroll for depth, rAF-throttled.
- parallax-stack: Layers that move at different rates as you scroll, computed once per frame.
- parallax-text: Headline that drifts at a different rate than scroll for depth.
- particle-field: Canvas particle drift with a DPR cap. No Three.js.
- period-drop: The full stop falls in with gravity, squashes on impact, and settles. One-shot keyframes when scrolled into view.
- physics-kanban: A board whose cards are thrown, not teleported. The card keeps its momentum.
- pinned-section: A section that sticks while its content scrolls past, and hands off cleanly.
- popover: Anchored floating panel with placement control.
- popover-bounce: Popover that pops in with a spring bounce and fades out.
- portfolio-hero-entrance: Staggered hero entrance: eyebrow, headline, subcopy and CTA arrive in sequence with spring easing.
- progress: Determinate progress bar with variant tones.
- progress-ring: Circular progress ring that animates to value on view.
- project-card-tilt: Project card with 3D perspective tilt following the pointer and a glare highlight that tracks.
- project-showcase: Project gallery section with filter pills, sticky sidebar, and hover zoom.
- pulse-ring: Status indicator: a solid dot wrapped by an expanding, fading ring. Reduced-motion aware.
- query-builder: Composable filter rows with field/operator/value and removable chips.
- radio-group: Single-select radio set with keyboard arrow navigation.
- radio-pill: Radio group rendered as a sliding pill selector.
- reveal-mask-image: Image revealed by an animated mask that wipes across on scroll.
- reveal-on-scroll: Intersection Observer-based reveal wrapper with multiple animation variants.
- rgb-glitch: Channel-split glitch bursts with clip-path slices and skew in theme-adaptive colors. Pure CSS, deterministic burst cycle.
- rich-text-editor: Formatting toolbar over contentEditable. Controlled value, sanitised output, no editor engine.
- rotate-card-stack: Stacked cards that fan out and rotate on hover with spring physics.
- rubber-band: Container that resists being pulled past its edge and snaps back with the velocity you let go at.
- scroll-fade-section: Section that fades and lifts into view once, driven by IntersectionObserver and reduced-motion aware.
- scroll-linked-path: An SVG path drawn by scroll position. Scrolling back up un-draws it.
- scroll-progress: Reading-progress bar that tracks an element, scaled with transforms so scrolling never lays out.
- scroll-progress-bar: Top reading-progress bar driven by scroll position, transform-scaled.
- scroll-snap-section: Section that snaps into place on scroll with smooth easing.
- scroll-triggered-counter: Counter that animates from zero to target on scroll into view.
- section-divider-line: Horizontal rule that draws itself from center on scroll into view.
- segmented-control: iOS-style segmented option picker with a spring-gliding accent pill, radiogroup semantics and full keyboard nav.
- selection-snap: Text snaps from hairline to black weight under a designer-style selection box with corner handles.
- separator: Thematic break and divider rules for grouping content.
- sheet: Side panel sliding from any edge with focus management.
- sidebar: Collapsible app sidebar with sections and active state.
- site-footer: Footer with brand, link columns, and status line.
- skeleton: Content placeholder matching final layout shape.
- skeleton-shimmer: Skeleton placeholder with an animated shimmer sweep.
- slash-commands: Notion-style slash menu with fuzzy filtering.
- slider: Range slider with value display and keyboard support.
- slider-glow: Range slider with a glowing thumb and value tooltip.
- slingshot-otp: OTP with real inputs, paste, and SR support. Standard mode by default; slingshot game is opt-in delight.
- speech-bubble-cursor: Custom cursor provider that shows speech-bubble tooltips.
- spinner: Activity spinner with sizes and live-region label.
- split-text: Reveal a headline word by word, character by character or line by line. Real text, one paint.
- spotlight-hover-card: Card lit by a radial spotlight that follows the pointer across its surface.
- spring: dt-based springStep + magnet + rafLoop. The physics behind magnetic effects.
- spring-carousel: Carousel that snaps on a spring, so a flick carries momentum to the nearest slide.
- staggered-grid: Grid whose cells fade and scale in with stagger on view.
- step-nav: Stepper navigation with current-step state.
- streaming-chat: Chat surface for a token stream. Bring your own transport: it renders the messages you pass and hands the input to onSend.
- switch: Labeled toggle switch built on a native checkbox.
- tabs: Keyboard-navigable tab set with panels.
- tabs-sliding-indicator: Tab bar with a sliding pill indicator that springs between items.
- tactile-loader: Three bouncing dots that announce themselves once.
- terminal: Terminal emulator UI with scrollback + command input.
- terminal-ui: Full terminal workspace: tab bar, sidebar tree, panes and a command input.
- testimonial-carousel: Auto-advancing testimonial carousel with spring snap and pause on hover.
- text-fx: Kinetic text in six kinds (typewriter, scramble, blur, gradient, glitch, morph). Screen readers hear the final text once.
- text-scramble-reveal: Text that scrambles through glyphs and resolves on scroll into view.
- textarea: Multiline text field sharing Input styling and semantics.
- thread-line: Animated SVG path that draws itself on scroll or on mount.
- toast: Transient notifications via provider and toast API.
- toast-slide: Toast notification that slides in from the side and auto-dismisses.
- toggle-switch-anim: Toggle switch with a sliding knob and color transition.
- token-meter: Token usage meter with role=meter semantics.
- tokens: Light + dark CSS vars + shared keyframes. Import once so components are styled on first paint.
- tool-call-viz: Timeline of agent tool calls with running/done states.
- tooltip: Hover/focus description bubble for controls.
- tooltip-fade: Tooltip that fades and lifts in on hover with delay and reduced-motion support.
- tui-help-overlay: Keyboard shortcut cheatsheet overlay. No primitive equivalent.
- tui-sparkline: Inline value sparkline for dense rows. No primitive equivalent.
- type-wall: Alternating solid and outline marquee rows under a fade mask. Pauses on hover, static under reduced motion.
- typing-indicator: Staggered bouncing dots, the classic 'someone is typing' affordance. Static under reduced motion. role=status.
- unified-login-field: One bordered container that morphs between email and password stages instead of juggling boxes. Shake on invalid email, Escape steps back.
- use-pointer-proximity: Window-level pointer proximity with rAF throttle. Attracts from radius away; fine-pointer only; zero cost under reduced motion.
- use-reduced-motion: SSR-safe prefers-reduced-motion via useSyncExternalStore. No hydration flash.
- utils: cn + clamp + fuzzyScore + formatBytes. Shared class-name helper for every component.
- version-history: Document version list with restore action.
- vertical-timeline: Timeline with dots, tick marks, connecting lines, and staggered scroll-reveal.

Collections: 112 creative, 67 kit.

Full machine-readable metadata: `registry/registry.json` (index), `registry/agent-catalog.json` (install + frameworks + docs + github per component), `registry/components/*.json`, `registry/generated/*.json`.
Per-component docs: `/components/{slug}`. Per-component source: `https://github.com/Varun9490/Buildora/tree/main/packages/components/src/{slug}`.

## Framework support (honest, generated from the catalogue)

- React: Full on all 179 components. React is the source of truth and the only tested full implementation. Install via shadcn above.
- JavaScript: 3 Full, 176 Partial — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- Vue (Composition API): 3 Full, 176 Partial — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- Svelte (runes): 3 Full, 176 Partial — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- Angular (@Input): 3 Full, 176 Partial — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- HTML: 2 Full, 177 Partial — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- Tailwind: 2 Full, 174 Partial, 3 Unsupported — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- React Native: 175 Partial, 4 Unsupported — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- Flutter: 2 Partial, 173 Experimental, 4 Unsupported — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- SwiftUI: 2 Partial, 173 Experimental, 4 Unsupported — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- Jetpack Compose: 2 Partial, 173 Experimental, 4 Unsupported — snippet-level ports, not a dedicated runtime. Interactive behaviour requires the React implementation. On mobile there is no hover/cursor — use press + haptics.
- Exceptions (generated): Full outside React: spring (JavaScript, Vue (Composition API), Svelte (runes), Angular (@Input)); tokens (JavaScript, Vue (Composition API), Svelte (runes), Angular (@Input), HTML, Tailwind); utils (JavaScript, Vue (Composition API), Svelte (runes), Angular (@Input), HTML, Tailwind). Unsupported: cursor-fx (React Native, Flutter, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose); spring (Tailwind); use-pointer-proximity (Tailwind, React Native, Flutter, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose); use-reduced-motion (Tailwind, React Native, Flutter, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose); utils (React Native, Flutter, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose). Check `registry/agent-catalog.json` `frameworks` per component before promising support.

## Cost (measured, not estimated)

- Median component: 1.44 KB gzipped. Per-component numbers in `registry/reports/bundle-size.json`.
- 89 of 179 components need no animation library at all.
- The 38 that do share one dependency (107.95 KB gzipped), paid once per project rather than per component.
